sources.title: Flood risk and coastal change
sources.facts: Explains flood zones, sequential and exception tests, coastal change and safe access.
sources.guard: Planning guidance and flood zones do not prove exact future depth or permission.

sources.title: Flood risk assessments: climate change allowances
sources.facts: Provides allowances used in flood risk and strategic flood risk assessments.
sources.guard: Allowances are scenarios and do not predict exact event timing or impact.

sources.title: National flood risk standing advice for local planning authorities
sources.facts: Sets consultation and assessment expectations for different flood-risk situations.
sources.guard: Standing advice does not approve a proposal or validate its mitigation.

sources.title: Flood risk assessments: applying for planning permission
sources.facts: Explains when an FRA is required and what it should assess.
sources.guard: An FRA requirement does not prove the submitted assessment is adequate.

sources.title: National Coastal Erosion Risk Mapping 2024
sources.facts: Shows projected erosion areas under shoreline-plan and no-intervention scenarios.
sources.guard: Projections have confidence ranges and are not exact parcel boundaries or dates.

sources.title: Shoreline Management Plan Mapping
sources.facts: Maps shoreline management policy units across short, medium and long terms.
sources.guard: SMP policy is strategic and does not guarantee funding or implementation.

sources.title: New national flood and coastal erosion risk information
sources.facts: Explains phased releases of new national flood and coastal risk datasets and climate scenarios.
sources.guard: Updated datasets still require correct interpretation and site-specific assessment.

sources.title: Refreshing the National FCERM Strategy for England
sources.facts: Sets the process for updating England’s long-term flood and coastal erosion strategy.
sources.guard: A strategy refresh does not prove project funding, defence condition or local delivery.
